data.name: io.github.beepboop2025/seiche
data.title: Seiche — funding-stress terminal
data.description: Funding stress early warning for US money markets from free public data, with an honest backtest.

environmentVariables.name: SEICHE_MCP_PUBLIC
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the six free public tools over stdio: funding_stress_now, historical_analogs, proof_backtest, data_health, crypto_stress_record, institutional_flows. The hosted endpoint gives an anonymous caller the same six with no token.

entries.description: Six anonymous tools for the current US dollar funding regime, historical analogs, data health, institutional positioning, crypto transmission, and the full backtest record.
representativeQueries: What is the current US dollar funding stress regime?
Are reserves, repo, reverse repo or Treasury cash signaling strain?
What historical episodes most resemble today?
How accurate has this funding stress model been?
How are hedge funds positioned in the Treasury basis trade?

entries.description: Curated OpenAPI contract for current funding conditions, series provenance, public methodology, and health endpoints.
representativeQueries: Give me an API for the current dollar funding regime.
Retrieve repo, reserves and Treasury cash conditions with provenance.
Check whether the Seiche data feeds are fresh.
